name: bb10-volte
scope: All 16 catalog entries admit full China three-carrier HPLMNs (Mobile 460-00/02/04/07/08, Unicom 460-01/06/09, Telecom 460-03/05/11/12) regardless of evidence status. Root, OS 10.3.3.3216, native ABI hashes, SIM identity, backup and recovery requirements remain. r47/mobile 0.1.0.47 restores MediaDialog.Omit200OkSdp=1 alongside MediaDialog.EarlySdp=0 in mt_voice_binary so precondition MT calls answered in reliable 183 Session Progress omit illegal duplicate SDP in 200 OK (INVITE) while non-precondition MT calls still attach the mandatory RFC 3261 SDP answer, adds SHA-256-pinned stock carrier XML fallback (404.xml/36.xml/446.xml) and two-phase empty-APN bootstrap when BB10 maps newer HPLMNs such as 460-08/09/05/12 to empty 0.xml, adds explicit SIM rejection diagnostics (including China Broadnet 460-15, ISIM applet, and downloaded carrier overrides), and retains r46 telecom_mo_ack + Navigator status-bar indicator. Previously published r42-r46 service payloads remain eligible for checked in-place upgrade after stopping VoLTE. Historical tested, untested and known-issue results stay version-specific; macOS remains the frozen r43 build.
